name: What a Legend!
description: What a Legend! is a puzzle-dungeon world originally built as a birthday gift for a VRChat user known as Legend, later released publicly for others to play. Visitors explore a central corridor branching into six themed portal realms, each crafted by a different "Cheese Guardian" (including Lakuza, CyanLaser, Mimi, and Phasedragon) with its own puzzles to solve. Collecting all six cheese pieces from these realms unlocks the door to a final room, completing the game-like experience.
